test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 6: Student Reviews and Plans
test_cases.test_case_title: Student Views Scheduled Sessions on Calendar
test_cases.pre_condition: A student named 'student_newuser' with email 'student_newuser@example.com' is successfully logged in and redirected to the Dashboard Page. The system has scheduled sessions available for the student's enrolled courses.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's calendar is displayed, showing all their scheduled sessions. The student can successfully switch between month, week, and day views, and can navigate to a session's course page by clicking a session link. The system displays the calendar with the updated view.
test_cases.post_condition: The student has successfully viewed their session schedule and can navigate through it. The student is ready to proceed to other course interactions or logout.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Calendar' page from the Dashboard.
Click the 'Calendar Navigation' buttons to switch between month, week, and day views.
Click on a 'Session Link' to view its details or navigate to the session's course page.
